articles.description: India's coal-fired power plants are currently experiencing critical fuel shortages due to rising energy demands. Despite escalating power demands, coal supply has fallen by approximately 5% this month.

articles.title: Global Market: European shares struggle for direction as France unrest weighs on sentiment
articles.description: European shares remained stagnant amid escalating unrest in France, raising alarms over fiscal health and growth prospects. While some optimism was generated from positive earnings reports by companies like Randstad and EssilorLuxottica, a downgrading of Carrefour's earnings forecast dampened investor sentiment. Additionally, new consumer inflation figures from Britain added layers of complexity to the interest rate and economic stability outlook, resulting in a market atmosphere marked by uncertainty and hesitation.

articles.title: Global Market: ECB sees Euro liquidity support boosting global currency role
articles.description: European Central Bank Chief Economist Philip Lane stated that stronger euro liquidity facilities can enhance the currency's global role. More than 30 central banks have expressed interest in the ECB’s expanded euro liquidity initiatives. These arrangements may boost confidence in the euro and encourage its use in international transactions. Additionally, euro area bond markets could benefit from higher official reserve purchases of euro-denominated assets.
